look_here_first: Start with scale and hairs: a very low suffrutescent mound with conspicuously ciliate opposite leaves and paired axillary pale pink-purple tubular flowers.

key_traits.text: small opposite elliptic leaves with rounded tips

key_traits.label: Identification
